description: Single source of truth for corpus ordering and reader-navigation labels. Each key must map to data/corpus/<key>.json.

source_review.status_scope: Containment/remediation state, not a rights decision.
source_review.evidence_model: the 2026-09-09 register is historical evidence and stays append-only; the dated 2026-09-20 correction overlay is authoritative for current status (it inherits the 2026-09-10 overlay's 35 per-document entries verbatim and records the Congrong Lu reinstatement as the 36th document); the dated 2026-09-20 Chuandeng Lu full overlay is the next authoritative record (it inherits the 2026-09-20 correction overlay's 36 per-document entries verbatim and records the full 30-fascicle Jingde Chuandeng Lu as the 37th document); the dated 2026-09-20 Caoshan Benji overlay is the next authoritative record (it inherits the 2026-09-20 Chuandeng Lu overlay's 37 per-document entries verbatim and records the Caoshan Benji record as the 38th document); the dated 2026-09-21 enthusiast-fulls overlay records the six full-witness documents — Huangbo T48n2012A, Mazu X69n1321, Yunmen T47n1988, Dongshan T47n1986A+B, Zhaozhou X68n1315 juan 13–14, Dahui T47n1998A+B — as the 39th through 44th; the dated 2026-09-21 combined Wumenguan/Linji overlay (sessions/COLLATION_REGISTER_2026-09-21_WUMENGUAN_LINJI.json) is the newest authoritative record: it inherits the enthusiast-fulls overlay's 12 per-document entries verbatim and records both re-keys — Wumenguan T48n2005 (48 cases, 207/207 fields EXACT, 0 flagged) and the Record of Linji T47n1985 (107 verbatim sections tiling the whole 16,366-CJK fascicle, 215 fields EXACT, 0 flagged) — as the 13th and 14th active documents, with both references added to the 19-work digest manifest; the designated flagged total stays 630 on the historical chain and the active flagged total stays 15 across the 14 active documents; purged 2026-09-21 retellings removed, 14 docs remain, flagged total 15
source_review.metadata_field_note: Title and name metadata (title_zh, name_zh) is measured and reported separately from source content, so collated_to_claimed_witness is not proof that the excluded metadata fields were collated.
source_review.non_approval_statement: Source collation does not approve reuse.
